title: [UE-0.10b] Anchor sprites
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Asset Specialist

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Art Director

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Art/Source/Anchors/**`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Art/Anchors/**`, `pipeline/art/provenance.csv`, `.github/workflows/pipeline-checks.yml` (sprite step)

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Art/Source/Anchors/**`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Art/Anchors/**`, `pipeline/art/provenance.csv`, `.github/workflows/pipeline-checks.yml` (sprite step)
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.7, UE-0.10a

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.4d, UE-0.10

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] Five anchors are imported at the card 0.3 Pixels Per Unreal Unit: Ella open, Ella closed, the owl, one clockwork bolt, the paper layer
- [ ] Each source PNG under `Art/Source/Anchors/` has a `.sprite.json` sidecar (frame grid and pivot from the `layout` entries of `pipeline/art/references.json`, SpriteLayout.json and Asset Notes.md; drawn new, never copied from a reference) and `python3 tools/sprite_check.py --scan Art --require-dir` prints 0 problems (pasted)
- [ ] `--require-dir` on the CI sprite step is the card's gate patch
- [ ] Kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.10b --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths)
- [ ] Each has a provenance row
- [ ] Round trip on one anchor: edit its layered source (one visible change), re-export, Reimport over the same `T_`/`SPR_` asset; `--import-report` errors=0 and `--sources Content/UmbrellaElla/Art Art/Source` PASS pasted, the map still loads, and the minutes it took are pasted. Over 10 min: the TD files a card for a one-command reimport + check + capture loop
- [ ] Each anchor is generated with `python3 tools/assetgen.py image` and is an art-loop piece (`python3 tools/art_loop.py pieces --card 0.10b`): kickoff runs builder and blind-critic rounds until it reaches the bar, and this PR pastes, for this commit, `python3 tools/art_ref_check.py --card 0.10b --element ID FILES` PASS and the `art_loop: PASS card=0.10b piece=...` line of each piece (`python3 tools/art_loop.py evidence --card 0.10b`). No human approves the look; the stuck rule (3 rounds with no improvement) raises NEEDS HUMAN

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
